title: Darkness CPVP
description: A dark themed cpvp texture pack!
body:
![This is how it looks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6fe47da2b07bf1b0df505005dfbdcb38a7b96a27.png)A black themed texture pack for cpvp players with custom dark themed, obsidian,end crystals,swords,netherite armors,diamond armors,and much more!

Especially made for cpvp players,with 3d custom end crystal models,animated totem.

## This pack contains:
- Custom dark respawn anchors
- Custom dark cying obsidian
- Low fire
- Custom clean and dark end crystal
- Custom dark obsidian
- Custom white glowstone
- 3D Crystal Model
- Custom diamond armor
- Custom netherite armor
- Custom diamond sword and pickaxe
- Custom animated totem and Firework Rocket
- Custom dark ender pearl,mace and elytra
- Custom grey golden apple
- Custom white enchantment glint
- Custom blue outline on ancient debris
